actions: Only read exact reviewed source and small existing records, and wrote this separate research report. No source/build/runtime/runner/control/Git changes, no compiler/checker launch, no process signal, no new full runtime hashing.

final_freeze_relocation.alternative_without_gate_change: Rebuild a fresh initially empty project at a new /tmp source_root/build identity and rerun audits, then use unchanged e04. This discards resume reuse and is unnecessary unless root chooses that tradeoff.
blocking_checks: clean_lock_evidence lines 215-218: original lean_arguments must name selected project path
clean_build_evidence lines 255-257: original source_root must equal selected project
clean_build_evidence lines 283-286: each recorded compiler argv must name selected project source path
final_freeze_relocation.current_e04_result: Unsupported by the unchanged gate, even if the duplicate source is byte-identical and the original build/audits completed.
legitimate_future_revision_only: Create a separately reviewed new gate revision/freeze schema that explicitly distinguishes immutable original compilation source_root from chosen replay source_root; preserve e04 and every old ORIGIN/receipt/command.

Before long replay, validate exact duplicate source set and all 4406 source hashes, lengths, imports, 3 configuration pins and candidate commit/tree against the original source lock and reviewed source manifests. Record an explicit source-equivalence bridge with original and duplicate roots and exact manifest/lock hashes. Do not assert the historical compiler ran from the duplicate.

Continue validating all original clean-build provenance, empty origin, complete successful SUMMARY, source/dependency/log/artifact receipts and recorded compiler argv using the original compilation root stored in ORIGIN. Compare source bytes to the duplicate through the same relative-name/hash mapping.

Bind completed exact118/broad audit evidence and its original frozen artifact/source identities through the explicit equality bridge; do not rewrite or relabel old audits as executed at the duplicate.

Keep the actual artifact root and runtime/cache paths unchanged. Generate a NEW freeze with the duplicate source/cwd plus exact new gate, bridge, locks, environment, manifests, audit provenance and old build records pinned under retained /tmp paths. Preserve source policy and package-owner exclusivity, full artifact/runtime universe checks and all pre/post checks.
Use unchanged official leanchecker --verbose --fresh D1Bound5, unchanged full import/replay scope and resource gates. Nothing in a path bridge constitutes kernel acceptance.

The new freeze should pin duplicate source paths, not require the old live workspace source paths after the completed-build/audit equivalence snapshot; otherwise the long replay remains exposed to the same disappearance. This is a new explicit provenance design, not something e04 currently allows.
final_freeze_relocation.path_independent_part: The source lock stores relative source paths, hashes, byte lengths, imports/topological order and auxiliary hashes; builder source_lock lines 195-215 do not store the root directory. Its bytes can remain unchanged for an identical duplicate.

observed_second_incident.cause: Unestablished. Workspace absence is observed; no deletion or source/control/process mutation was performed by this reviewer.
observed_second_incident.qualification: 1810 accepted pointers survive, but reuse still requires the original guarded resume revalidation; no complete build claim.

guard_sources: Build.__init__ lines 315-377: source closure/auxiliary equality, no source artifacts, identity equality, full runtime/source/inventory and resume checks
guard_runtime lines 396-423: actual executing runner and lock bytes, runtime universe and selected bundles
resume_passes lines 463-485: PASS/zero-exit, build/identity/source hashes, recursively accepted dependency receipts, log and artifact bundle checks
same_identity_resume.inode_semantics: Pins is newly constructed each invocation. Restored source inodes/mtimes need not equal the previous invocation, but before/after fingerprint equality during hashing and exact SHA256 checks remain mandatory. No cached prior metadata is trusted across invocations.
same_identity_resume.mount_namespace: A bind mount is not implemented or recommended by this review: it would need separately authorized environment setup, recorded mount identity and lifecycle checks, and its cleanup safety is not established.
movable_auxiliary_paths: Exact builder source pathname (identity binds its SHA, not filename)
Runtime-lock filename (contents and SHA unchanged; its internal absolute runtime paths must stay fixed)
Hints/control/launch/evidence paths (operational, not identity fields; record exact new argv and before/after control bytes)
must_not_move_for_same_identity: Runtime/cache paths in runtime lock and environment
same_identity_resume.required: Restore the exact source closure and configuration at the original resolved source_root, retain the existing /tmp build_dir and runtime paths and environment, and use the exact builder/lock bytes. Preserve all old records and start a new --resume invocation.
same_identity_resume.retention_limit: Moving auxiliary paths reduces exposure but leaves live source access at the original path. A durable byte-exact /tmp backup enables restoration; it is not a guarantee that the platform will retain either directory.
same_identity_resume.symlink: A source-root symlink to a new /tmp tree changes Path.resolve() and therefore identity/Lean -R; not a supported continuation. Do not bypass the guard.
